items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He loved Charlie Chaplain movies and I had some of the Charlie Chaplain silent movies so I would put them on.

ctx.x: One of the guys in the band.

Yeah and it made it wonderful for us because I‟m here and he is over there and Katherine has got this big Olympic swimming pool and a cabana and all that and she would invite all these big clubs and National Conference of Christians and Jews and she had [unintelligible] donors of Africa to have their fashion shows over there.
